title: How Flash Loan Mechanics & Composability Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph TX["Single Atomic Transaction"]
        A["Attacker calls flashLoan()"] --> B["Borrow huge temporary capital"]
        B --> C["Move cheap-to-move state"]
        C --> D["Protocol reads the lie"]
        D --> E["Downstream action settles"]
        E --> F["Repay loan plus fee"]
    end
    C -.-> P1["DEX price / reserves"]
    C -.-> P2["Vote tally"]
    C -.-> P3["Share price"]
    C -.-> P4["Slippage floor"]
    F --> G["Keep manipulated profit"]

title: Attack Vector
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Start["Flash-loan large capital"] --> Branch{"Target surface?"}
    Branch -->|"Spot oracle"| O1["Push pool reserves"]
    O1 --> O2["Read slot0 / getAmountsOut"]
    O2 --> O3["Mint/borrow/liquidate at lie"]
    Branch -->|"Governance"| G1["Deposit gov token"]
    G1 --> G2["Vote with no snapshot"]
    G2 --> G3["Execute malicious proposal"]
    Branch -->|"Sandwich"| S1["Front-run victim swap"]
    S1 --> S2["amountOutMin=0 or circular min"]
    S2 --> S3["Back-run to reset pool"]
    O3 --> Profit["Repay loan, keep profit"]
    G3 --> Profit
    S3 --> Profit

title: Defense Pattern
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Q["Quantity decides real money?"] --> Principle["Split read and write across blocks"]
    subgraph Oracle["Price defenses"]
        D1["Use Chainlink / off-chain quote"]
        D2["TWAP window >= 30 min"]
        D3["Native withdrawal queue"]
    end
    subgraph Gov["Governance defenses"]
        D4["Snapshot voting power"]
        D5["Timelock execution delay"]
    end
    subgraph Slip["Slippage defenses"]
        D6["minOut from independent source"]
        D7["Reject amountOutMin = 0"]
    end
    Principle --> Oracle
    Principle --> Gov
    Principle --> Slip
